content: निष्क्रमः .²1 Going out, coming forth; अविभावितनिष्क्रमप्रयाणः <ls>Ki. 13. 27</ls>. .²2 Departure from, exit. .²3 One of the Saṃskāras or religious rites; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} taking out a child for the first time into the open air (which is usually performed in the fourth month of its age); चतुर्थे मासि निष्क्रमः <ls>Y. 1. 12</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> उपनिष्क्रमण also. .²4 Degradation, loss of caste, inferiority of tribe. .²5 Intellectual faculty.
